title: Flashings.
officialText:
Flashings shall be reconstructed in accordance with approved manufacturer’s installation instructions. Metal flashing to which bituminous materials are to be adhered shall be primed prior to installation.
*SOLAR PHOTOVOLTAlC PANELS/MODULES AND REQUIRED SUSTAINABLE ROOFING ZONES
*The title of Section 1511 was amended by Local Law 94 of 2019. This law has an effective date of November 15, 2019.
